description: bluechonk 的 ZCode 插件市场。

description_i18n.zh-CN: bluechonk 的 ZCode 插件市场。

plugins.name: deepseek-web-search
plugins.description: DeepSeek official web search and page fetch: zero-dependency CLI plus matching commands, skills and MCP servers.

description_i18n.en: DeepSeek official web search and page fetch: zero-dependency CLI plus matching commands, skills and MCP servers.
description_i18n.zh-CN: DeepSeek 官方联网搜索与网页抓取：零依赖 CLI，并配套 command、skill 与 MCP 服务。

plugins.name: plan-gate
plugins.description: Deny state-changing tools until the current turn is planned with TodoWrite, and mirror the todo list to disk.

description_i18n.en: Deny state-changing tools until the current turn is planned with TodoWrite, and mirror the todo list to disk.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 本轮未规划时拦截会改状态的工具，并把待办清单镜像到磁盘。

plugins.name: security-review
plugins.description: Pattern-based security warnings on edits, plus an end-of-turn LLM review of the turn's git diff run against the model ZCode is currently using.

description_i18n.en: Pattern-based security warnings on edits, plus an end-of-turn LLM review of the turn's git diff run against the model ZCode is currently using.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 编辑后即时做安全模式检查；每轮收尾时用 ZCode 当前在跑的模型审查本轮的 git diff。
